transcript.message: Understood—monthly affordability matters, especially with a young family. The 900 sq ft, 3-bedroom, 2-bath layout may be worth assessing for your own stay. For the three of you, it offers a separate room for your child, but it’s still worth judging against your actual furniture and storage needs. A 30-year tenure can be used as an illustration, but the instalment would still depend on the approved loan amount and rate.
